snippet.title: The Wide Open Sky is Running out of Catfish Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: May 2025
snippet.description:
A story-driven photography game... on the back of a giant, flying catfish! Transform clouds into sea creatures and bring abundance back to an empty sky!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172760/The_Wide_Open_Sky_is_Running_out_of_Catfish/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
